resources.string: Choose files or a folder, or share them to Topal Encryption from another app.
Choose .topal files, or a folder that contains them.
%s could not be read and will be left out.
No files to encrypt in this selection.
Checks that the password is right and that every encrypted file is intact. Nothing is written.
Write this passphrase down or save it in a password manager before you continue.
The two passwords do not match.
There is no password recovery. If you forget the password, the files cannot be opened by anyone.
Your original files are kept. Nothing is deleted.
You can leave the app: the job carries on, and its progress is in the notifications.
Skipped files already had an output with the same name.
Written as app installers, under names the encrypted files did not show: %s. Install them only if you trust where the encrypted files came from.
Files that were not finished were left untouched.
None of the files could be opened. Nothing was changed.
This is not a valid recovery key. Check it for typing mistakes.
Wrong password, or the file header is damaged
Wrong recovery key, or the file header is damaged
This file was not encrypted with a recovery key
The file content is damaged or incomplete
The encrypted folder contains an unsafe path
An output with this name already exists
Made by a newer version of Topal Encryption
The file asks for more memory or work than is allowed
The file could not be read or written
This file can only be read from here, so its password cannot be changed. It was not touched. Choose it with “Add files” or “Add folder” from a place that allows changes.
Something went wrong inside the app
Gives encrypted files a new password without re-encrypting them, so it takes seconds. An older copy of a file still opens with the old password.
These files can also be opened with recovery key %s.
Recovery key %s is on: these files can also be opened with it.
A recovery key is a second way to open your files if you forget the password. Create it in Topal Encryption on your PC, then bring its public half here.
On the PC, the public half is the file recovery-public.txt in %APPDATA%\\TopalEncryption. Choose that file, or paste its text.
The public half only adds the recovery key to the files you encrypt. It cannot open anything. Keep the secret key itself off the phone.
A recovery key is on. Files you encrypt from now on can also be opened with it.
Key ID (must match the one shown on your PC):
Removing it does not take it out of files that already have it.
This is not a valid public recovery key. It starts with TOPAL-PUB; check it for typing mistakes.
This is the secret recovery key, the one that opens your files. It was not stored. Import the public key (recovery-public.txt) instead.
The file could not be read.
When off, the app is kept out of screenshots, screen recordings and the recent apps preview, because passwords and recovery keys are typed here.
Check for updates once a day
When off, the app looks for updates only when you press “Check for updates”. When on, it also asks GitHub once a day when you open it. Nothing is downloaded until you say so.
Password-protects files and folders on your phone.\nThe same open-source encryption as the desktop app, so files open on both.

The app uses the internet for one thing only: looking for a new version on GitHub and downloading it, and only when you press “Check for updates” or when the daily check is switched on (it is off by default). An update is installed only if it is signed with the same key as this app, and Android asks you before installing.
Version %s is downloaded, and it is signed with the same key as this app.
Waiting for Android to install it…
Android has to be told that Topal Encryption may install its own update. Allow it on the screen that opened, come back, and press Install again.
Wait for the running job to finish first.
Test build: it looks for updates as if it were version code %s.
GitHub could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
The answer from GitHub was not understood. Try again later, or get the update from the project page.
The newest release has no Android download yet. Try again later.
The download is larger than an update can be. It was discarded.
The download could not be saved. Free some space and try again.
The download is damaged, or is not an app. It was discarded.
The download is a different app. It was discarded.
The download is not newer than this version. It was discarded.
The download is not signed with the key Topal Encryption is signed with. It was discarded and nothing was installed.
Android could not install the update.
